attackers_goals: The attacker attempts to gain access to the accounts.
description: Multiple failed remote logins originated from an external IP with at least one successful login. This may indicate a successful brute-force attack.
investigative_actions: If the source IP is an internal IP, adjust network IP ranges. Identify the user performing RDP and check that it is authorized. Check whether this IP has a malicious reputation. Reset the user's password. Follow further actions done by the user.
